scope: Reverse-aware shared road/terrain anticipation and direction-bound convoy observation. Selected HBQ RoadAhead/sector intent only, not a full controller/precision review or behavioural parity.

sourceWitnesses.scope: Directional sector declaration/implementation lines1-34 only; not renewed whole helper review

finding: CBE road branch/approach bearing and ordinary terrain sampling used forward hull heading even during native reverse travel. Collision/rear observers already had separate direction custody, but did not correct this earlier road/terrain ceiling. Existing convoy lead/revision changes reconstruct local state and already invalidate the road cache; only travel direction was missing from its reuse condition.
implementation: DrivingRoadCap optional direction1/-1 changes initial road-walk/approach bearing by180degrees for backing. Invalid direction returns requested min15 without road lookup. No route is chosen or written.

DrivingAssistStart observes signed longitudinal motion and explicit native BACK near rest, reverses its existing terrain sample vector and passes that direction to shared road observer. Later detailed native reverse/track/task custody remains unchanged.

ConvoyTick passes the same direction and refreshes cached road cap when direction changes, retaining existing3second cadence otherwise. Existing state rebuild already covers lead/roster/revision; no duplicate ownership cache added.
ASL bridge/road endpoints, accepted-piece geometry, turn/junction/grade policy, original bounds and all lower feature/mission/traffic/pedestrian/recovery caps preserved.
cost: Two cheap live motion/mode observations in existing ordinary/convoy callbacks. No new scheduler, handler, setting, worker or world discovery. Existing8transitions/9metadata/16connections bounds retained. Direction changes may cause one earlier road walk per existing convoy callback; unchanged cadence preserved. Measured cost unknown.
deliberateDepartures: HBQ RoadAhead itself uses hull-forward heading and applies source conditional crossing/turn caps. CBE combines its anticipation intent with directional observation, retains conservative junction caps and endpoint-based grade. Does not claim identical balance, route selection or physical performance.
precisionGap: Per-vehicle HBQ precision/player-distance observation LOD remains unimplemented. Prior cost decision preserved: do not reduce sensing or reaction accounting without latency/observation-age/physical and cost evidence. Current4s cruise/1s constrained cadence is not equivalent to HBQ precision tiers.
remaining: Physical native backing through bends/grades and bridges, transition from BACK to forward, stationary unknown-mode behaviour, convoy succession and cost remain unverified; audits paused.
Shared road walk remains heading-based, not the native planned route; this grants no clearance. Whole HBQ/source integration and actual external-provider handovers remain open.
